summary: Configured and enabled a persistent nftables host firewall on node1. SSH and TCP 8080 are accepted; unrelated inbound traffic is explicitly rejected. Configuration and behavior survived the mandatory node reboot.
actions_performed: Installed the validated ruleset at /etc/nftables.conf and enabled nftables.service.
Verified TCP 22 and 8080 connectivity and TCP 9090 rejection using an isolated network namespace.
Safely rebooted node1 and confirmed its boot identity changed.
Reverified network recovery, boot-time firewall loading, configuration integrity, and firewall behavior.
Removed all temporary test listeners, links, and namespaces.

evidence.requirement: Persistent host firewall enabled on node1
evidence.summary: nftables is enabled, boot loading succeeded, the configuration checksum persisted, and the live INPUT chain has policy drop with an explicit final reject.

evidence.requirement: Permit SSH and TCP 8080 while rejecting unrelated inbound connections
evidence.summary: With listeners confirmed on ports 22, 8080, and 9090, post-restart probes reached 22 and 8080 successfully; 9090 failed while the reject counter increased.

Captured the healthy pre-restart state, acknowledged a safe scheduled reboot, observed disconnection, confirmed boot ID changed from 1db3db2e-dca8-44d6-8402-3b99605ae056 to 6095eabe-b8aa-4631-919b-4719fb8414b0, and proved network and firewall recovery.
Confirmed removal of the probe namespace, veth links, and temporary listeners.
